Name: CUTSCENE_GPARAM_TIME_PARAM_ST
Description: Picks the time zone used for lighting (GPARAM) during a cutscene. Each field covers the time zone the cutscene starts in and names the CutsceneTimezoneConvertParam row (0-6) whose Cutscene Time is used while it plays.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Timezone: Morning
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Morning zone (CutsceneTimezoneConvertParam row 0). The value is a CutsceneTimezoneConvertParam row (0-6) whose Cutscene Time is used during the cutscene.

Fields.Name: Timezone: Noon
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Noon zone (row 1). Same values as Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Timezone: Afternoon
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Afternoon zone (row 2). Same values as Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Timezone: Evening
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Evening zone (row 3). Same values as Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Timezone: Night
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Night zone (row 4). Same values as Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Timezone: Midnight A
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Midnight A zone (row 5). Same values as Timezone: Morning.

Fields.Name: Timezone: Midnight B
Fields.Description: Time zone used when the cutscene starts in the Midnight B zone (row 6). Same values as Timezone: Morning.
